sentences.text: The genus Archaeopsittacus contains only one known species, Archaeopsittacus verreauxi.
Lambrecht named this genus in 1933 after finding fossils near Saint-Gérand-le-Puy, France.
Researchers believe Archaeopsittacus is closely related to Old World parrots and may belong to the superfamily Psittacoidea.
This animal lived approximately 23 million years ago during the Late Oligocene or Early Miocene.
Scientists cannot definitively classify Archaeopsittacus beyond the superfamily Psittacoidea because there are not enough unique physical traits in the fossils.
